title: Character Bible Record
description: The canonical, human-edited description of one character (cast/<id>/character.yaml). Every image prompt that shows this character is assembled from these fields by lib/character_bible.py; approved reference images live beside it in refs/. Code never rewrites this file. See skills/meta/character-bible.md.

id.description: Kebab-case id; must match the character's folder name.

name.description: The name used in scripts and prompts.

status.description: draft while the look is being designed; locked once the master reference is approved. A locked identity is changed only on purpose (see the skill).

locked_on.description: ISO date the master reference was approved.

variant_of.description: The id of the same person at another age or in another era (time jumps), e.g. meera-young -> meera.

speech.description: How the character talks: register, slang, catchphrase.

relationships.description: other character id -> relationship, e.g. raj: husband.

identity.description: The locked look. Pasted verbatim into prompts; never paraphrased.

summary.description: Short noun phrase, e.g. 'a 34-year-old Indian woman'.

marks.description: Distinguishing details: a mole, a scar, spectacles.

accessories.description: Worn in every outfit: mangalsutra, bangles, watch.

description.description: Full description, used in text-only prompts and outfit reference jobs.

short.description: Short form used in the 'keep exact …' lock clause, e.g. 'faded green cotton saree'.

poses.description: pose id -> canonical pose text. An approved image may exist at refs/poses/<id>.jpg.

expressions.description: expression id -> canonical expression text. An approved image may exist at refs/expressions/<id>.jpg.

ref_notes.description: Extra instruction about this character's reference images, e.g. 'Ignore the paint strokes and labels in the reference sheet.'

forbidden.description: Drift traps and never-dos for this character, checked at image QA.

fal_entity.description: Optional mirror of this character in the fal asset library (read/write through the fal MCP).
